question: On a pull request's head: after a push, is every required check pending again; does a required check conclude `timed_out`, `neutral`, `skipped`, `cancelled` or `stale` and keep that conclusion until the content changes or a person runs it again; is every check run read with its exact name and its App's id, two workflow runs on one commit both staying, since `filter=latest` is per check suite; and can any App with `checks: write`, or any Actions job, post a check run under a required Lens's check name, or a result for any criterion of a contract, one the contract does not name among them, which then stays on that head?
pass: Written 2026-11-13T05:35:20Z, before anything is pushed or read (issue 807's first box, the two rules a read alone cannot record): on a new canary pull request to main, whose p2-queue.yml waits 60 s on pull_request so its required check, p2-queue-check, stays pending long enough to be read, the Maintainer's own login reads the facts port's own query, `adapters/checks.py` QUERY at PAGE 100, word for word, its variables as the port sends them: (a) on head A once p2-queue-check has concluded; then pushes head B, and reads at once and again, nothing done between but reads, (b) until p2-queue-check on B is read not concluded, and (c) until it is concluded. Pass if all hold, each read through `adapters/checks.read`: (1) every read is whole, of the pull request's head; (2) at (a) p2-queue-check on A has concluded success; (3) at (b), the head being B, p2-queue-check is read on B queued or in progress, with no conclusion, though it had concluded on A: the push set the required check pending again; (4) at (c), with nothing asked of GitHub but reads since (b), p2-queue-check on B has concluded success or failure: it reported on its own. Fail otherwise, naming which. Ran on 2026-11-13, as the Maintainer's own login: canary pull request 113 (trial/p807-push) opened at 05:36Z with head A; p2-queue-check on A was read in progress four times and concluded success at 05:37:00Z. Head B was pushed at 05:37:13Z (git push, its answer not recorded). The two reads at once after it, at 05:37:15Z and 05:37:17Z, gave the head as B and no p2-queue-check on it at all; the third, at 05:37:19Z, gave it queued; then in progress at every read until 05:38:30Z, when it had concluded success, nothing asked of GitHub between but these reads. Passed: (1) every read is whole by `adapters/checks.read`, of the pull request's head; (2) at (a) p2-queue-check on A concluded success; (3) at (b) the head is B and p2-queue-check on it is queued, with no conclusion, though it had concluded on A: the push set the required check pending again, and for four seconds GitHub listed none on B at all; (4) at (c), with only reads since (b), it concluded success: it reported on its own. Undone after: the pull request closed and its branch deleted; its workflow runs stay, as every trial's do.
